comparator.name: Educational Sciences (Onderwijswetenschappen)
comparator.academicYear: Current UvA published bachelor curriculum, checked 2026-09-27
comparator.sourceNotes: The official overview states a 180-EC, three-year bachelor. The curriculum page labels 174 EC directly and lists Inleiding Pedagogische & Onderwijswetenschappen 2 and ACVA A/B without separate EC figures; a single 6-EC reconciliation component records those published integrated modules so the documented degree total remains exact. Year 2 totals 60 EC. Year 3 totals 60 EC, including an 18-EC empirical thesis and 30 EC of genuine free-choice/minor space. No particular elective or minor is invented.

alternatives.label: Learning, development & educational research
alternatives.concept: Combines psychology, lifespan development, social context, qualitative and quantitative methods, policy and evidence synthesis to study how people learn and how educational practice can improve. It is the closest feasible UCR response, although UCR lacks dedicated curriculum studies, instructional design and educational assessment sequences.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed plan centres behavioural and social accounts of learning, lifespan development and an unusually strong empirical-methods sequence.
progression: The validated UCR sequence places gateways and methods before advanced psychology, sociology, policy and research work; all planned terms are available and nine 300-level courses are included.

alternatives.label: Digital learning, cognition & communication
alternatives.concept: Develops the programme’s explicit future-of-learning-and-technology strand through cognition, neuroscience, data science, AI ethics, language and persuasive communication. It supports analysis and responsible design of digital learning without claiming UCR offers a specialist educational-technology degree.
alternatives.labelReason: The course set gives sustained weight to cognition, language, AI, data methods and communication as foundations for technology-supported learning.
alternatives.distinctness: Relative to the closest plan, this direction replaces the sociology, politics, economics and public-policy spine with neuroscience, cognition, programming, AI, machine learning and language. More than 30 EC changes and the educational question shifts from broad educational improvement to digital learning design.
progression: Mathematics, data, psychology and programming gateways precede advanced AI, cognition and research courses; all prerequisites and offerings pass, with ten 300-level courses.

alternatives.label: Organisational learning, innovation & leadership
alternatives.concept: Builds from the official lifelong-learning and learning-in-organisations strand, combining organisational psychology, leadership, strategy, entrepreneurship, social research, information systems and persuasive communication for workplace learning and educational innovation.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed plan joins organisation and leadership courses to research, digital systems, communication and innovation.
alternatives.distinctness: This plan replaces the closest route’s psychology, health, politics and economics depth with entrepreneurship, digital transformation, organisational psychology, information systems and strategic communication. It differs from the digital-learning plan by more than 30 EC and centres organisational change rather than cognitive mechanisms.
progression: Business, data, methods and social-science foundations precede advanced organisational psychology, entrepreneurship, communication and computing; all prerequisites and offerings pass, with eight 300-level courses.

selection.assessment: The broad behavioural, social and methods plan is the closest feasible UCR composition. The official technology and organisational-learning strands also generate two coherent and substantially distinct curricula. All three pass current UCR feasibility checks and differ pairwise by well over 30 EC, so production stops at three.

notes.text: The UvA programme is a dedicated Educational Sciences degree with compulsory curriculum studies, instructional design, assessment, educational policy, field orientation and an empirical thesis. UCR can assemble strong behavioural, social, research, technological and organisational foundations, but it does not reproduce that profession-specific sequence or confer the same disciplinary degree identity.
